question: The excessive quantities of chemicals which get washed from the fields act as nutrients for ______ to flourish.
solution:
The correct answer is __**algae**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The excessive quantities of chemicals which get washed from the fields act as nutrients for **algae to flourish.**
 
• Excessive quantities of chemicals (fertilizers, weedicides,insecticides, pesticides) get washed away from the fields entering into water bodies like ponds,rivers,sea.
 
• These act as nutrients for** algae to flourish.**
 
• Once these algae die, they serve as food for decomposers like** bacteria.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Eutrophication: 

 
 
• ​It is an enrichment of water by nutrient salts that causes structural changes to the ecosystem.
 
• Compounds that contain nitrogen and phosphorus (fertilizers) drives eutrophication.
 
• These nutrients are generally not toxic.
 
 
 
• Effects:
 
 
• They can have a large impact on the health of rivers and estuaries such as increased production of algae and aquatic plants, depletion of fish species, general deterioration of water quality.
 
 
 
• Causes of Eutrophication
 
 
• Fertilizers (nitrates and phosphates).
 
• Concentrated animal feeding operations.
 
• Direct sewage discharge and industrial waste into water bodies.
 
• Natural events such as floods and the natural flow of rivers and streams can also wash excess nutrients off the land into the water systems thus causing excessive growth of algal blooms.
